metadata.title: UMi Practitioner Portal
metadata.description: UMi practitioner portal: invite your patients and follow their engagement.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your practitioner portal.
login.resendConfirmation: Email not confirmed? Resend the link

signup.title: Create a practitioner account
signup.subtitle: A few details to get started.
signup.terms: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.
signup.termsRequired: You must accept the terms to continue.

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.body: We sent a confirmation link to your address. Click it to activate your account, then sign in.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for this email, a link has just been sent.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.success: Password updated. You can now sign in.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Please start over.

dashboard.subtitle: Here's an overview of your patients' engagement.

empty.title: Invite your first patient
empty.body: Generate an invitation code to give a patient access to the UMi app, then follow their engagement effortlessly.

patients.title: Your patients
patients.subtitle: Follow the engagement of all your patients.

empty.title: No patients yet
empty.body: Invite a patient to start following their engagement.

exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.subtitle: Done or not done, over the attachment period.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Exercises completed per day (last 14 days).
activity.total: Total: {count, plural, one {# exercise} other {# exercises}} over 14 days.

patientDetail.endedBanner: Follow-up ended. This profile is read-only; the history remains available.
patientDetail.resumeBanner: Follow-up ended, this profile is read-only. The patient can resume until {date} by re-entering the code above in the app.

invite.title: Invite a patient
invite.description: Generate an attachment code to share with your patient.
invite.sendEmailHint: Enter an email to enable sending.

success.title: Invitation created
success.instructions: Share this code with your patient: they create their account on the UMi app, then enter this code to get attached.
success.emailSent: The code was also sent to {email}.
success.emailFailed: The email could not be sent, share the code manually.

confirmRevokeSeat.title: End follow-up?
confirmRevokeSeat.body: The patient will lose access to the UMi app. You can restore the follow-up for 30 days if the patient re-enters their code; after that, a new code will be required.

confirmDeleteSeat.title: Delete this patient?
confirmDeleteSeat.body: This follow-up will be permanently removed from your portal and its code released. The patient's data in the app is not affected. This action cannot be undone.

confirmRevokeInvite.title: Cancel invitation?
confirmRevokeInvite.body: The code will become invalid and can no longer be used by the patient.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Portal language. Your preference is remembered.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.body: Subscription management will arrive in a future version.

errors.notPractitioner: Your account is not a practitioner account.
errors.notOwner: This seat does not belong to you.
errors.seatNotInvited: This code has already been used and can no longer be changed.
errors.seatNotActiveOrInvited: This seat cannot be revoked in its current state.
errors.seatNotDeletable: This patient cannot be deleted in its current state.
errors.codeGenerationFailed: Code generation failed. Please try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Your email is not confirmed yet. Check your inbox.
errors.userAlreadyExists: An account already exists for this email.
errors.weakPassword: The password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

forbidden.title: Practitioners only
forbidden.body: This area is reserved for practitioners. Your account does not have a practitioner profile.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: Something went wrong on our side. You can try again.
errorBoundary.contact: If the problem persists, contact support.

legal.title: Legal & Privacy
legal.placeholderNotice: Provisional content, to be finalized by UMi.

editor.title: Publisher
editor.body: UMi, psychological support solution. Publisher details to be completed.

privacy.title: Data protection (GDPR)
privacy.body: The portal processes data strictly limited to engagement tracking (exercise done or not done), with no clinical content. Practitioners never access their patients' personal content. Full privacy policy to be completed.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any question regarding your data, contact UMi support. Contact address to be completed.
